title: The test registry
description: Every test the repository holds, generated from the test files and published by the docs build, as help.json is. A test's id is derived, never declared. A run's result and a check's findings are kept under build/ beside it (moondeck/docs/test_runs.py, moondeck/check/_findings.py).

id.description: kind:path::name for unit, python and js (the file and the test's own name), kind:name for a scenario (its file stem) and a check (its script). Derived from the test, so a rename is a new test and git is its history.

subject.description: What a test is about: a module type as help.json names it, or a class or script where it is not a type. Links to the help and MoonWalk exist where the subject is a type.

size.description: Google's test sizes: small in one process, medium on the desktop with a server, large on hardware or a network.

title.description: A unit test's sentence, a scenario's name, a check's one line.

file.description: The path of the test, relative to the repository.

subjects.description: From a unit test's @module and @also, and a scenario's module and also.

controls.description: Type.control, from a scenario's set_control and expect_control steps, each with the type its instance has at that step.

steps.description: process/step ids the test proves, named in the test (a steps_proved key, a @step tag); the generator checks they exist.

sequence.description: A scenario's own steps in order: what it does and what each step is for. They are not process steps.

perf.description: A measured step's numbers per target: the contract it is held to and the range it was observed in.

run.description: The MoonDeck call that runs it.

description: The registry: every test by its id.
